name: nzchar_sgr
title: Test for a character outside SGR

origin.description: Test for a character outside SGR.
origin.usage: nzchar_sgr(x, keepNA = NA, warn = getOption("fansi.warn", TRUE))

arguments.name: keepNA
arguments.text: NA or omitted returns TRUE for a missing string. TRUE returns NA.

origin.details: nzchar_ctl with ctl set to sgr. keepNA defaults to NA, so a missing string is TRUE.

translation.description: Test for a character outside SGR.

arguments.name: keepNA
arguments.text: NA or omitted returns TRUE for a missing string. TRUE returns NA.

translation.details: nzchar_ctl with ctl set to sgr. keepNA defaults to NA, so a missing string is TRUE. A string is a length-one vector, and None is a missing string.
translation.example:
from fansi import nzchar_sgr
print('nzchar_sgr("\\033[31m") returns %s.' % nzchar_sgr("\x1b[31m")[0])
